get_topk_predictions: get top-k candidate predictions from a reranker model using a train dataloader and candidate pool
run_get_topk_predictions: run the get_topk_predictions function to score candidates against context inputs and return top-k results
test_get_topk_predictions: test the get_topk_predictions function with a reranker, dataloader, and candidate pool to verify top-k retrieval
review_get_topk_predictions: review the get_topk_predictions function that scores candidates using a reranker and tracks hit-rate statistics per domain
refactor_get_topk_predictions: refactor the get_topk_predictions function to support batched multi-domain scoring with per-world statistics tracking
